messages:
andrew: quick proposal 1: create a lightweight "Action Board" for PM followups (kanban-style) so owners can't drop items. board columns: Backlog / In Progress / Blocked / Verification / Closed. link tasks to PM and auto-schedule checks.

sophia: nice. how do you envision reminders and escalation?

andrew: ops-bot posts check-ins at configurable SLO thresholds, e.g., P1: 12h, 72h, 14d; P2: 24h, 7d, 30d. if a card is Blocked for 2 checks -> escalate to oncall lead and create a short unblock ticket.

mike: add a monthly "recurrence review" lane: if a service appears in >2 PMs within 90d, cards are auto-moved to Recurrence Review and ping platform/product for deep dive.

eva: love the board. small template for card description?

andrew: short one-liner + acceptance criteria + linked incidents + SLO + owner. example snippet: `Owner: @name | SLO: 14d | Verify: link`

sophia: process ask: rotate IC every 2 weeks (Mon 09:00 UTC). keep a secondary oncall for weekends. publish roster and give IC rights to move board cards.

mike: metrics: track average time in Blocked, reopen rate, and recurrence-count (90d). set alert when recurrence-count >=3.

ops-bot: i can provision board hooks and schedule nudges: `@ops-bot board create <pm-id> --slo p1=12h,p2=24h --notify owner,oncall-lead`. need board integration enabled.

eva: can we try a 4-week pilot on customer-impact PMs only? small group to validate friction.
andrew: plan: i'll open PR with board design, card template, ops-bot commands, and rotation rules. if no objections in 48h we'll run a 4-week pilot. :thumbsup:
